description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for Git hooks related to reference transaction hooks, including setup, execution, and various scenarios of hook interactions and ref updates.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case, executing provided commands and expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the executed command fails.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the output or error of previous commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Schedules cleanup actions after the test.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or strings, asserting they are identical.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites needed to run certain tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
